title: Boba Fett Bonds with his New Rancor
description: Down below in the rancor pit, Boba Fett speaks to the rancor keeper, and meets his new pet. Enthralled with the creature, Fett sees beauty where few others do. The keeper tells Boba of the other side of rancors, a more peaceful side. Often bred and trained for fighting, it is not necessarily in their nature. Rancors can be quite loving, and will imprint on the first being they see. When the keeper tells Fett of the Witches of Dathomir riding rancors through the forest, Boba decides that he will as well, and they get to work on training.
